inherited_release_gate.note: All sealed dev7 HORNET propagation, dev6 prism wall, dev5 full armor/grounded CRAB, PROGRESSIVE assembly, native-format, mod-package and source-only gates remain inherited. Dev8 adds the five-build MANDALA initial-combat assembly.

fresh_package.note: Candidate was extracted fresh, verified against RELEASE_MANIFEST with no unlisted files, independently source-audited before executing package code, and then passed 90/90 selftests plus CLI/GUI version and MANDALA-control checks. Final package is rebuilt deterministically after recording this evidence.

limitations: MANDALA preset is the deterministic state-7 activation snapshot; later 32xBC inner-phase members are deliberately not included.
MANDALA B7-BB native animations are preserved; no arbitrary internal GMX pose sample is frozen.
No radial-facing orientation is invented for MANDALA pieces because no such runtime callback was recovered.
HORNET state-6 propagation and prism-wall catalogs remain runtime families rather than one canonical random result.
Native SIIG coordinate scale is preserved; no speculative meter conversion or hidden display scaling is applied.
Assembly export produces a combined glTF viewing/editing scene; it does not claim the retail game stores or accepts one merged native GMX.
Runtime acceptance of arbitrary fully original synthesized scenes remains a separate emulator/hardware gate.
Platform shader microcode compilation and remaining opaque GMX semantics remain unresolved.
Compressed/mipmapped native texture variants are not synthesized.
PS3 NPDRM/SDAT re-encryption is not implemented.
